summary.en: Amalasuntha governed for her son Athalaric. The palace mosaic still recalls her father’s court in Ravenna.

summary.de: Mit der Übergabe der Stadt an Belisar endet hier die ostgotische Kontrolle. Der Krieg ging anderswo weiter.
summary.en: The city’s surrender to Belisarius ended Ostrogothic control here. The war continued elsewhere.

summary.de: Eine Belagerung, eine Getreideration, ein gestempeltes Bleirohr und Hände aus Mosaiksteinen erschließen das Italien Theoderichs. Von Verona bis zur Übergabe Ravennas an Belisar.
summary.en: A siege, a grain distribution, a stamped lead pipe and hands picked out in mosaic open up Theoderic’s Italy. From Verona to the surrender of Ravenna to Belisarius.

description.de: Die Kapitel zur Völkerwanderung führen durch die spätrömische Welt. Die Funde an der unteren Weichsel reichen in die römische Kaiserzeit zurück und gehören zur Vorgeschichte der Reihe.
description.en: These chapters follow the Migration Period in the late Roman world. Evidence on the lower Vistula goes back to the Roman Imperial period and introduces the earlier history of the series.

summary.en: Theoderic’s following emerged from rivalry among several leaders in the Balkans. In Italy men from the opposing army also joined him.

note.en: After Theoderic’s death his young grandson Athalaric succeeded. His mother Amalasuntha governed for him and sought the support of existing officials and the Senate through the letters announcing his accession.

note.en: The opponents agreed to share power. Shortly after entering Ravenna Theoderic killed Odoacer. His army acclaimed him as king.

note.en: After the battle on the Adda, Theoderic besieged Odoacer in Ravenna. A source records an exceptionally high price for wheat inside the besieged city.

note.en: After negotiations Ravenna opened its gates to Belisarius. Witigis was taken captive to Constantinople. Ravenna remained in imperial hands during the rest of the war.
